5.7.5.14 InitEvent
Purpose: A runnable entity triggered by the RTE for initialization. Signature:
[SWS_Rte_06748] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00240
⌈
void <name>([IN Rte_Instance <instance>])
⌋
Notes: The runnable entity triggered by an InitEvent RTEEvent is supposed to be used for initialization purposes. It is not guaranteed that all RunnableEntitys referenced by this InitEvent are executed before the ’regular’ RunnableEntitys are executed for the first time.
